note: NeuroStudio Pose Catalog v1 (NS-026). Original descriptions; no AI Pose Gallery data. views/crops/poses use the composition option ids of src/composition.ts. IDs are stable: never renumber or reuse them.

poses.description: One forearm along a window ledge.
poses.body: Standing, shoulders at an easy diagonal.
poses.hands: Near forearm lies along the ledge; far arm hangs loosely.
poses.legs: Both feet grounded, near knee relaxed.
poses.support: Both feet and the near forearm on the ledge.
poses.risks: Keep the resting wrist in line with the forearm.

poses.description: Seated upright with palms on separate thighs.
poses.body: Upright on a low stool or chair, shoulders level.
poses.hands: One relaxed palm on each thigh, fingers together.
poses.legs: Knees slightly apart, both soles flat.
poses.support: Seat and both feet.
poses.risks: Keep each hand over its own thigh; show shoes only in full body.

poses.description: A shoulder against the wall, face turned toward the light.
poses.body: Standing at a slight diagonal, upper arm touching the wall.
poses.hands: Arms hang; the wall-side hand may fall outside the composition.
poses.legs: Feet hip-width apart, weight mainly on the inner foot.
poses.support: Both feet with light wall contact.
poses.risks: Keep the wall-side shoulder at its natural height.

poses.description: Leaning toward a table on two parallel forearms.
poses.body: Sitting, torso inclined from the hips.
poses.hands: Forearms lie parallel on the tabletop, hands visibly apart.
poses.legs: Feet planted below the knees.
poses.support: Chair, floor and forearms.
poses.risks: Keep the table edge clear of the wrists.

poses.description: Turning back from a balcony rail.
poses.body: Hips face the rail; shoulders and head turn partway back.
poses.hands: Near palm sits flat on the rail; far arm stays low.
poses.legs: Feet slightly staggered, toes generally toward the rail.
poses.support: Both feet and one palm.
poses.risks: Show the supporting elbow and keep the turn of the spine small.

poses.description: A hand on a chair back, shoulders square.
poses.body: Standing next to the chair with the torso upright.
poses.hands: Near palm lies on top of the chair back without gripping; far arm hangs.
poses.legs: Feet parallel, weight evenly distributed.
poses.support: Both feet and light palm contact.
poses.risks: Avoid wrapping the palm behind the chair edge.

poses.description: Seated sideways with one forearm on the chair back.
poses.body: Pelvis square to the seat; chest opens toward the viewer.
poses.hands: Near forearm follows the top of the backrest; free hand on the near thigh.
poses.legs: Both feet flat, knees pointing away at a shallow diagonal.
poses.support: Seat, feet and one forearm.
poses.risks: Separate the free elbow from the chair silhouette.

poses.description: A quiet stroll with one foot just landing.
poses.body: Tall torso in an easy walking stride.
poses.hands: Arms swing only slightly, hands below the hips.
poses.legs: Front heel down, rear toes on the ground, narrow stance.
poses.support: Front heel and rear toes.
poses.risks: Keep the stride short and the near and far legs in order.

poses.description: Fingertips on the pages of an open book on a stand.
poses.body: Standing with a small forward nod toward the book.
poses.hands: Near fingertips rest on an open page; the other arm hangs.
poses.legs: Feet parallel, knees loose.
poses.support: Both feet and light fingertip contact.
poses.risks: Place the fingertips on the page surface with the book edge clear.

poses.description: A quiet straight-on portrait with relaxed shoulders.
poses.body: Head centered over an upright trunk, chin slightly lowered.
poses.hands: Arms stay below the composition.
poses.support: Standing or seated; support not visible.
poses.risks: End the composition clearly above the elbows; keep the neck visible.

poses.description: Sitting by a window with the torso in profile and elbows low.
poses.body: Sitting upright, eyes toward the window.
poses.hands: Window-side forearm rests on the sill; the free arm lies on the lap.
poses.legs: Feet flat, knees parallel.
poses.support: Seat, both feet and the window-side forearm.
poses.risks: Keep the sill below the shoulder.

poses.description: Resting a hip lightly against a counter edge.
poses.body: Standing with a small side shift toward the counter.
poses.hands: Near hand flat on the counter; far arm hangs beside the hip.
poses.legs: Near leg bears the weight; the far foot stays on the ground.
poses.support: Near foot with light hip and hand contact.
poses.risks: Keep the pelvis almost level; leave daylight between the far elbow and the torso.

poses.description: Face just past profile with a long, relaxed neck.
poses.body: Shoulders angled away, head turning back to near profile.
poses.hands: Arms lowered, below the composition.
poses.support: Both feet, not visible.
poses.risks: Show a clean jawline and leave room above the near shoulder.

poses.description: Sitting with one palm on the seat edge.
poses.body: Sitting, upper body inclined a little toward the braced arm.
poses.hands: Near palm flat beside the hip; far hand flat on its thigh.
poses.legs: Knees side by side, both feet flat.
poses.support: Seat, near palm and both feet.
poses.risks: Keep the fingers on the seat surface so they do not merge with its edge.

poses.description: One hand resting lightly against the upper chest.
poses.body: Torso upright with a small turn toward the raised arm.
poses.hands: Near palm over the collarbone, fingers aligned; far arm hangs.
poses.support: Both feet; the hand touches the chest lightly.
poses.risks: Keep the fingertips clear of any necklace and preserve the wrist contour.

poses.description: Perched on a wide step, one knee higher.
poses.body: Seated with a straight back, hips centered on the step.
poses.hands: Near palm on the higher thigh; the other palm on the step beside her.
poses.legs: One foot on the lower tread; the other rests one tread higher.
poses.support: Seat tread, both feet and one palm.
poses.risks: Give both knees clear silhouettes; include the soles in full body.

poses.description: A slight turn toward a map spread on a table.
poses.body: Standing; ribcage and hips turn together toward the table.
poses.hands: Near forearm lies beside the map; the free hand hangs by the hip.
poses.legs: Feet in a short stagger in the direction of the turn.
poses.support: Both feet and the near forearm.
poses.risks: Keep the forearm visibly beside the map so it does not read as gripping.

poses.description: Looking down past a relaxed shoulder, seen from slightly above.
poses.body: Seated; head inclines forward while the shoulders stay level.
poses.hands: Hands stay low, flat on either side of the lap.
poses.support: Seat and feet.
poses.risks: Keep the elevation mild to limit foreshortening of the neck.

poses.description: Beside a doorway with one forearm braced low.
poses.body: Torso opens away from the doorway; the head follows.
poses.hands: Near forearm leans on the jamb below shoulder height; the other arm down.
poses.legs: Near foot under the hip, far foot a little to the side.
poses.support: Both feet and the near forearm.
poses.risks: Keep the elbow and the jamb as separate edges.

poses.description: Sitting at an angle with both forearms on armrests.
poses.body: Pelvis centered, shoulders gently turned toward the light.
poses.hands: Forearms lie on separate armrests, hands relaxed over their ends.
poses.legs: Feet flat, side by side.
poses.support: Seat, both feet and armrests.
poses.risks: Keep the armrest ends away from the fingertips.

poses.description: A pause on a stair landing with one hand on a broad rail.
poses.body: Torso upright, about to turn toward the stairs.
poses.hands: Near hand flat on the broad rail; far arm loose at her side.
poses.legs: Feet on the same landing, one foot angled outward.
poses.support: Both feet and light contact with the rail.
poses.risks: Show the rail running under the palm; keep the wrist rotation small.

poses.description: A small hinge from the hips to study something below eye level.
poses.body: Small forward hinge, long back, head in line with the trunk.
poses.hands: Palms on the tops of separate thighs.
poses.legs: Heels planted, both knees softly bent.
poses.support: Both feet; light hand pressure on the thighs.
poses.risks: Keep the hands high enough to stay inside a mid-thigh composition.

poses.description: A gently lifted face in a still, centered portrait.
poses.body: Seated, chin gently raised, upper body facing ahead.
poses.hands: Forearms rest on the thighs, below the composition.
poses.support: Seat and feet.
poses.risks: Keep the lift slight so the nose and jaw remain distinct.

poses.nameRu: Локоть на столе, ладонь у лица
poses.description: One elbow on a table, open hand beside the face.
poses.body: Seated, torso inclined gently toward the planted elbow.
poses.hands: Near elbow on the table with the forearm upright, open hand beside the cheek; far hand stays low.
poses.legs: Both feet flat, knees under the table.
poses.support: Seat, both feet and the near elbow.
poses.risks: Leave a visible gap between the fingers and the face; show the elbow contact.

poses.description: A relaxed contrapposto with one hand on the hip.
poses.body: Standing with the weight on one leg; hips and shoulders at gentle opposite angles.
poses.hands: One hand on the hip with the elbow out; the other arm hangs loosely with soft fingers.
poses.legs: The free foot steps slightly out to the side, both soles on the ground.
poses.support: The weight-bearing leg.
poses.risks: Keep the hand on the hip flat with the fingers together; leave a clear gap between the bent elbow and the waist.

poses.description: Looking back over the shoulder from a rear three-quarter view.
poses.body: Back half turned to the viewer; the head turns toward the viewer over the near shoulder.
poses.hands: Near arm hangs relaxed along the side; the far hand rests on the hip.
poses.legs: Weight on the far leg, near heel slightly lifted.
poses.support: The weight-bearing far leg.
poses.risks: Keep the head turn moderate so the jaw and neck stay natural; the far hand may be partly hidden by the body.

poses.description: Standing tall with relaxed arms and a slight turn of the shoulders.
poses.body: Upright; the shoulders turn slightly from the hips.
poses.hands: Both arms hang naturally, hands relaxed a little away from the thighs.
poses.legs: Feet hip-width apart, weight even.
poses.support: Both feet.
poses.risks: Keep the hands slightly away from the hips so both silhouettes read.

poses.description: A calm profile with one hand lightly holding the other wrist.
poses.body: Standing in profile, long back, chin level.
poses.hands: Hands meet in front of the hips, one hand lightly holding the other wrist.
poses.legs: Feet close together, weight even.
poses.support: Both feet.
poses.risks: Show the holding hand clearly; avoid interlaced fingers.

poses.description: An unhurried walk toward the viewer.
poses.body: Upright torso, relaxed shoulders, gaze ahead or toward the viewer.
poses.hands: Arms swing only slightly, close to the body.
poses.legs: Short natural stride, the front heel touching down.
poses.support: The landing heel and the rear toes.
poses.risks: Keep the stride short so both legs stay readable and distinct.

poses.description: Walking away and glancing back.
poses.body: Back to the viewer, head turned partway back over one shoulder.
poses.hands: Arms relaxed with a slight swing.
poses.legs: Short stride away from the viewer.
poses.support: Front foot and rear toes.
poses.risks: Keep the head turn moderate; both feet should read as walking away.

poses.description: An over-the-shoulder portrait.
poses.body: Back and near shoulder toward the viewer, face turned back in three-quarter.
poses.hands: Hands stay below the shoulder line, mostly outside the composition.
poses.support: Standing or seated; support not visible.
poses.risks: Keep the near shoulder lower than the chin so the neck stays long.

poses.description: Arms loosely folded below the chest.
poses.body: Standing upright, shoulders relaxed, a slight turn toward the light.
poses.hands: Forearms folded loosely, each hand resting on the opposite upper arm.
poses.legs: Feet hip-width apart.
poses.support: Both feet.
poses.risks: Keep the fold loose so both hands stay visible on the upper arms.

poses.description: Sitting sideways on the ground with the legs folded to one side.
poses.body: Upright torso turned toward the viewer, hips on a blanket, rug or lawn.
poses.hands: One palm flat on the ground beside the hip; the other hand on the upper thigh.
poses.legs: Both knees bent and folded together to one side.
poses.support: Hips, folded legs and one straight arm.
poses.risks: Keep both lower legs together and fully visible on one side; the supporting arm stays straight.

poses.nameRu: Лежит на боку, опора на предплечье
poses.description: Lying on one side, propped on a forearm.
poses.body: Upper body raised on the forearm, head level, torso facing the viewer.
poses.hands: Supporting forearm flat under the shoulder; the free hand lies on the hip.
poses.legs: Legs stacked with the knees softly bent.
poses.support: Forearm, hip and the surface beneath: a bed, sofa, blanket or grass.
poses.risks: Keep the supporting shoulder above the elbow; the stacked legs must stay two separate shapes.

poses.description: Half reclining against cushions on a chaise or sofa.
poses.body: Back resting on cushions, upper body raised, chin level.
poses.hands: Arms rest along the body; one hand on the cushion, the other on the lap.
poses.legs: Legs extended along the seat, knees softly bent.
poses.support: Cushions, seat and backrest.
poses.risks: Show the backrest clearly so the incline reads as supported.

poses.description: Sitting at a three-quarter angle with the hands at rest on the lap.
poses.body: Upright on a chair or bench, shoulders relaxed.
poses.hands: One hand lies over the other on the lap.
poses.legs: Knees together, both feet flat and angled the same way.
poses.support: Seat and both feet.
poses.risks: Keep both hands readable as two shapes, the upper one relaxed.

poses.description: Standing with both hands in the pockets of a coat, jacket or trousers.
poses.body: Upright, shoulders relaxed, a slight turn from the hips.
poses.hands: Both hands inside the pockets up to the wrists.
poses.legs: Feet hip-width apart, weight on one leg.
poses.support: Both feet.
poses.risks: Use only with an outfit that has pockets; show the wrists entering the pockets.
